summary: Backend Phase 2 (AMASS Agent Ecosystem) verified. 21/24 tests passed (87.5%). Two real bugs found: (1) POST /api/admin/agents/{user_id}/badge rejects JSON body with 422 (`loc: ["query","data"]`) — endpoint is treating the Pydantic `AdminPinBadgeIn` as query params instead of a request body, likely because the model is declared inside the router-factory closure without an explicit `Body(...)` annotation. (2) POST /api/payments/paystack/webhook crashes with 500 (`json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value`) when hit with an empty body — signature check is skipped in MOCK mode (secret is empty) and `await request.json()` blows up. All other Phase 2 features work: public profile by slug + user_id fallback, unknown slug 404, suspended agent 410 with reinstate, public listings (no archived, sorted), badge rules catalog (4 tiers), badge progress (current=verified, next=trusted, 4 checks), non-admin 403, account deletion (data scrubbed incl. wallets + token_transactions, JWT invalidated, login rejected), slug backfill idempotent across `supervisorctl restart backend`, and full Phase 1 regression sweep still green.

critical.issue: Returns 422 for a valid JSON body `{"tier":"top_agent"}`. Pydantic error `loc: ["query","data"]` shows FastAPI is treating the `AdminPinBadgeIn` model as a query parameter. Root cause: the class is declared inside the `register_agent_platform_v2_routes` factory (line 446 of agent_platform_v2.py) which appears to break FastAPI body inference in the installed FastAPI/Pydantic-v2 combo. Fix options: (a) move `AdminPinBadgeIn` to module scope, (b) annotate the param as `data: AdminPinBadgeIn = Body(...)`, or (c) use `Annotated[AdminPinBadgeIn, Body()]`. Reference: /app/backend/agent_platform_v2.py:446-459.

Crashes with HTTP 500 on empty body / missing signature. `await request.json()` throws JSONDecodeError because the empty-body path isn't guarded. In MOCK_PAYMENT=true mode PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY is unset so signature verification is skipped and every malformed payload reaches the parser. Should return 200 (or 401 if signature enforcement is on). Reference: /app/backend/payments.py:306-322. Same class of bug likely exists on /api/payments/flutterwave/webhook (payments.py:325-340). Fix: wrap in try/except and return early, e.g. `try: payload = await request.json() except Exception: return {"ok": True}`.

action_items: Fix admin badge pin endpoint: either move `AdminPinBadgeIn` outside the closure OR annotate parameter as `data: AdminPinBadgeIn = Body(...)` in /app/backend/agent_platform_v2.py:450-451 so JSON body is accepted (currently 422 on every request).

Harden Paystack + Flutterwave webhooks to not crash on empty / non-JSON bodies. Wrap `await request.json()` in try/except at /app/backend/payments.py:312 and payments.py:332 — return 200 (or 400) instead of 500.
After fixing the two issues above, re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_agent_platform_phase2.py -n 0` — expected 24/24 green.
critical_code_review_comments: agent_platform_v2.py — `AdminPinBadgeIn` Pydantic class is declared inside `register_agent_platform_v2_routes` (line 446). This works with older FastAPI but with the current Pydantic v2 stack causes the model to be inferred as query params. Recommend moving all request/response Pydantic models to module scope for consistency and stability across FastAPI upgrades.

payments.py — both webhook handlers assume the body is always valid JSON. Since signature verification is skipped when the secret is absent (MOCK mode), any probe / health-check hitting the webhook URL will 500. Add a defensive JSON parse.
agent_platform_v2.py `_ensure_slug` — retries collision detection up to 5 times then silently accepts a possibly-still-colliding slug. Low risk in practice but worth logging on the 5th attempt.

agent_platform_v2.py `/account/delete` — swallows per-collection exceptions with a bare `except Exception: pass` (lines 398-399, 417-418, 425-426). If Mongo throws for a real reason (e.g. permissions) the deletion silently under-scrubs and returns ok:true. Consider logging.

Fixture STATE is shared at module scope. After E1 fixes the two open bugs, expect 24/24 green.

admin_badge_endpoint_422.root_cause: FastAPI + Pydantic v2 fails to auto-detect the closure-scoped `AdminPinBadgeIn` model as a body param. The `data` field is instead treated as a required query parameter of type `AdminPinBadgeIn`, which is unsatisfiable.
admin_badge_endpoint_422.mitigation: Annotate: `data: AdminPinBadgeIn = Body(...)` OR promote the class to module scope. Adding `from fastapi import Body` at top of the module.

paystack_webhook_500.root_cause: payments.py:312 calls `await request.json()` unconditionally. When MOCK_PAYMENT=true and PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY is empty, the signature check on lines 308-311 is skipped (empty secret is falsy), so the parser sees an empty body.
paystack_webhook_500.mitigation: Wrap in try/except and short-circuit with 200. Same fix applies at flutterwave_webhook (payments.py:332).
